.]] in Dazar'alor.]] .]] Meeting Stones, also known as Summoning Stones, are very large thumb-shaped stones with a mystical, glowing symbol that appear next to instanced dungeons. Originally, they were for filling in partial (or just-starting) parties whose members met the required level range by auto-inviting suitable candidates. In patch 2.0.1, Meeting Stones were reworked with the implementation of the new LFG system. They now are used to summon party members to the stone near an instance. One player targets a faraway player and clicks the Meeting Stone, creating a portal. When a second player clicks the portal, the targeted player is given a summoning dialogue very similar to the warlock

The mechanostrider (or Mechano-strider) is the mount used by the gnomes of the Alliance. They were invented by a young Gelbin Mekkatorque, launching the young gnome's fame and setting him on the path of leadership as High Tinker.
Meggi Peppinrocker is a goblin located in Everlook in Winterspring.

Melea is a night elf mail armor vendor located in the Tradesmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos. She could be saved.

Mechbuilder's Overalls is a cloth chest piece with some decent attribute boosts and a minor Arcane Resistance. It is one of very few (perhaps the only) chest pieces which require Engineering to wear. It is popular with Engineers for this reason, though more for the novelty than for the bonuses.

Medallion of the Dawn is an epic melee necklace, designed for non-raiding / non-pvp players. It is acquired via Argent Dawn quests turn-ins. Players in established raiding guilds can quickly earn better items; however, guilds gearing up to begin raiding for the first time may consider these rewards worth the time it takes to farm them.
Mekgineer Steamrigger is the second boss in The Steamvault of Coilfang Reservoir. It is a large bipedal robot controlled by leper gnomes.

The Medallion of Karabor is an epic necklace that provides stamina and shadow resistance. It was originally held by draenei priests in order to allow them entrance to the Temple of Karabor. Now it serves the same purpose for adventurers seeking to challenge Illidan Stormrage, who has taken residence in the Temple of Karabor - now called the Black Temple.
The Medallion of the Valiant Guardian is a quest reward from the Alliance quest Turning the Tide (quest) and Turning the Tide (BC Classic).
Medallion of the Horde is a PvP reward, and can be purchased from the following vendors for : * in Hall of Legends, Orgrimmar * in Dalaran * in Gadgetzan, Tanaris

Medicinal Purpose is a Draenei-only quest in the draenei starting zone Azuremyst Isle. Players are sent to gather from the lashers around Azure Watch, which will be used to revive an injured night elf priest currently at the draenei camp.
This quest is part of the Friend of the Sin'dorei quest chain. This quest chain starts with Friend of the Sin'dorei.
Melted Candles drop from the following kobolds in Elwynn Forest: * Kobold Worker * Kobold Laborer * Kobold Vermin

Megzeg Nukklebust is a goblin that can be found in Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula. He has been hired by the Horde to shore up defenses and build explosives and other killing machines. He completes his assigned tasks with great aplomb.
The Medical Supplies are located around the Cryo Core in Bloodmyst Isle.

Meklo was the older goblin in charge of creating the Dragon Soul and armor for Neltharion during the War of the Ancients. He was always muttering calculations to himself. Meklo's status in the immediate aftermath of the war is unknown, but as it has been ten thousand years since then he is long since dead. His role would be filled by Kryll millennia later.

Meeda is a goblin banker located in Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

Mekgineer's Chopper is a chopper vehicle created by top Alliance engineers. This vehicle allows one party member to ride along in the sidecar. It's one of the few mounts that can be bought on the Auction house, however it will usually cost plenty of gold, considering the price of the mats to create it.

Mei Francis is a vendor found in Dalaran that sells unique mounts. She sells the Armored Brown Bear and all the Mammoth mounts, including one with passenger spots and vendors. She will also mail players mounts obtained through achievements or the Blizzard Online Store, such as the Winged Guardian, Reins of the Albino Drake, Celestial Steed and Hearthsteed.

Medivh's Chambers, located near the summit of Karazhan, are the private bedchambers and study of Medivh, the last Guardian of Tirisfal. The room contains a worktable, an elevated bed, and many paintings and statues. To enter Medivh's Chambers, it's recommended that Karazhan be cleared first, as there are several fleshbeasts within the room. There are two entrances; the first, which appears to be the "front door", is just outside the Gamesman's Hall on the way to Prince Malchezaar. Leave the Gamesman's Hall and enter the doorway to the left, and up the ramp to the door. The second entrance, which appears to be the "back door", is halfway up the staircase to the tower summit. Medic Helaina is a neophyte first aid medic located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. When Aegwynn and Sven found an exhausted Valeera Sanguinar, they brought her to Theramore. Helaina was then said to have helped the blood elf. It's unknown if she survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.

Mel'Thandris Starsong sacrificed her life during the final battle of the War of the Satyr. The Shrine of Mel'Thandris was made in her name, where she was probably buried, with the Scythe of Elune, that was secretly entrusted to her by Malfurion before her demise. The Shrine is mentioned in Velinde's Journal, which is written by Velinde Starsong, Mel'Thandris' niece. She is the author of the Tome of Mel'Thandris.

The Mechano-Tank Attack Target is just a target for you to aim and fire at when you are in the Shooting Mechano-Tank. Note that you do have to actually hit the target. While the pellets spread a good bit, you CAN miss the target entirely if you are too close.

A melodium can capture a performance on a musical instrument and later use the instrument to replay the performance automatically. Each type of instrument requires its own type of mellodium. The music is captured to a hard wax tablet inside the mellodium, and can be replayed at any time using a mellodium attached to the same instrument; though other mellodiums use the same tablets, music recorded on other instruments will be played as noice.

Megs Dreadshredder is a goblin quest giver found in many locations of Tanaris. Megs was also part of the goblin starting experience as the Kajaro Trading Company marketing rep on Bilgewater Port. While stationed at the Dunemaul Recruitment Camp Megs and the Dunemaul "Emissary" successfully recruit the Dunemaul clan into the Horde. During the Legion Invasions, Megs defended Gadgetzan as well as her camp with the help of the Bilgewater Muscles and the Emissary.
Mekgineer Mixeltweed is part of a gnomish expedition who excavated a cursed tomb. He has lost his sanity and wants access to all of the deepest Uldum vaults.

Medearn is a Blizzard employee who posts on the US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11112 Customer Service Forum]. He was introduced on March 28, 2012 along with Linsivi. He has left the company.
Meko Skychaser is a tauren shaman formerly at the Razor Hill in Durotar using his healing totem to aid the wounded trolls and tauren during the Darkspear Rebellion.

Mei Pa is a pandaren angler, sister to Kuo, and cousin to Shi Ga. One stormy night when the three were fishing they rescued a drowning Alliance soldier named Tarlo Mondan. After rescuing Tarlo they continued, and invited him to joining them in, fishing. As they fished they told Tarlo the tale of Xun, and remarked afterwords that they seek to continue Xun's work by not only feeding others but to forge their own legacies and stories.

Meldheron is a Blizzard employee and one of the English language Community Managers for the European World of Warcraft community, normally encountered on the EU forums, specifically the [http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/forum/ English WoW forums]. Their first post was on 2013-02-05.

Morjirn, head brewer of a nearby clan, harboring jealousy of Master Melba's skill, sent a band of raiders to kill her, and steal the recipe. Megan Wallace is a former Blizzard Entertainment employee, where she spent 9 years designing the administrative organization and supported several executives including the CEO.
Mel's Journal can be found on the counter in front of Mel Lynchen in the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.
The Medivas are a group of singers who are inspired by Medivh. They do not only go Medivh's One Night in Karazhan party but also host their own party called Party Portals!.
Mekkatorque's Secre is a submarine located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
Medivh's Echo is a buff applied to players who collected a Soul Fragment in Return to Karazhan. The buff will change into Medivh's Presence once five Soul Fragments are collected.

Medivh's Presence is a buff applied to players who collected all five Soul Fragments in the Return to Karazhan. The Image of Medivh will be visible at the Opera Hall Balcony for the duration and can start the encounter for Nightbane.
Melancholy Mule is a mule located in the camp of Hunter Robin in Stormsong Valley.

Meekoo is a tortollan located at the Seekers' Vista in Stormsong Valley. He sits with a Hearthstone Board. He brought his board along, and can be found at the Hissing Grotto in the Waking Shores. He is sitting next to Taneqi.
Meet Mischief – The New Warcraft Pet is an official trailer promoting the purchasable companion pet Mischief. It takes place during Winter Veil.
Mekgineer Thermaplugg's Brag-Bots were Alarm-o-bots located in Dun Morogh during the Operation: Gnomeregan.

Meerah is a vulpera initially encountered at the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun. Throughout the Vol'dun storyline, she transports the adventurer and their companions through the desert using her carriage drawn by her two alpacas Dolly and Dot. She is cheerful and kind, but Nisha states that she is blind to the true dangers of the desert.
Mekaru is a vulpera quest giver found next to a wagon west of the Brine Basin in Vol'dun, next to Neri.
Meijani is a Zandalari troll quest giver located in the Valley of Sorrows in Vol'dun.
Mechanoranger Cogspark is a gnome mounted on a mechanostrider located in Ruins of Lordaeron during the Battle for Lordaeron.

Meerah's Caravan is a caravan wagon owned by Meerah and pulled by her two alpacas Dolly and Dot. Throughout the Vol'dun storyline, Meerah, the Horde adventurer, and their companions ride the caravan to various location in Vol'dun, first from Vulpera Hideaway to the Withering Gulch, then from the Withering Gulch to the Temple of Akunda. While traveling through Redrock Pass to Zul'Ahjin, the caravan is ambushed and set on fire by General Jakra'zet's assassins. However, afterward, it can seemingly be found intact back at Vulpera Hideaway.

__NOTOC__ Meeki is a dead vulpera lying on the southernmost pier in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. He was a scout from Camp Lastwind who snuck into Zem'lan in order to figure out a route for Camp Lastwind's vulpera to steal the port's treasure, but he was evidently killed by the port's residents.
Meerah's Jukebox has a chance to drop from Voldunai Supplies.
Meli'wa is a Zandalari troll located at Taste of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. She was present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation.

Mechantula is a mechanical spider battle pet created with Kul Tiran and Zandalari Engineering (125). The schematic is learned from Schematic: Mechantula, purchasable for 1 Pristine Gizmo from Micro Zoox in Dun Morogh.
The Mechashark X-Steam is a mechanical Hammerhead shark located in the Dire Strait in the Lost Isles. The shark is controlled with the Mechashark X-Steam Controller in order to defeat The Hammer.

Mechanocats are mechanized cats found mostly on Kul Tiras. A tiger and a house cat variation exist. The original mechanocat prototype was designed by Head Machinist Sparkflux himself when Mechagon was first founded. The cat's superior speed and handling far outclassed all other vehicles available at the time. Yet despite its unparalleled performance, the mechanocat was never mass produced, as the less expensive mechanocrawler was widely considered a more cost effective mode of transportation for King Mechagon's military forces. Melanie Charles can be found at the Brewfest Grounds during Brewfest in Dun Morogh.
The Mechano-Treat is created with Junkyard Tinkering. It can be used on mechanical battle pets.

of Terenas Menethil.]] The Menethils (sometimes called the Menethil Dynasty) were the ruling family of the Kingdom of Lordaeron prior to the nation's destruction and the murder of King Terenas Menethil II by his son, Prince Arthas at the start of the Third War. The house was known for their kindness to the Wrynns during the Second War, when the Horde ruled over the lands of Stormwind. The Menethils ruled for many decades, with Terenas' reign alone lasting 50 years. Terenas's grandfather is said to have had successful negotiations with the elves of Quel'Thalas over the borders there for his northern vassals. Menethil's Gift refers to the pentagram-like symbol upon the ground at the slaughterhouse in Stratholme. Baron Rivendare stands not far from it. Menethil's Gift is ground that was 'blessed' by the Lich King. It is the Scourge-equivalent of holy ground. It was the site where Ras Frostwhisper committed suicide and was raised as a Lich. Menag, a lord of the Bloodhill Bandits, robbed the farmer Gerard and his wife Matilda when Arthas was near Strahnbrad. Menag stole Gerard's ledger, full of vital information regarding the estate of the local farmer. Without the ledger, Gerard would lose his farm. Menag then fled with his men across a river as he saw Prince Arthas, a paladin, approaching. Arthas hunted Menag down at the request of Gerard, killed Menag and his band, and got the ledger back. In Reforged, he is shown to be a rogue wizard.

The Menagerie Wreckage is a small area along the path to Odesyus' Landing containing multiple crashed cages and escaped ravagers. The caged creatures tumbled from the Exodar before it plowed into Wildwind Peak on the western part of the Azuremyst Isle, and now threaten the local fauna with their alien presence. The area now looks like a crashed crystal pod, with crystal shards of various sizes scattered throughout.

__NOTOC__ A memoizing table is a normal table with a metatable designed to find missing values and save them. The mechanics are transparent to the caller, it thinks it's just doing a normal lookup. Memoizing tables are especially handy for caching values which are expensive to lookup or calculate. The developer generally expects that for a given index the value won't change, so it does not need to be recomputed after the first lookup.
